newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's MDM buys stake in Multisource.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's MDM buys stake in Multisource.

text.p: South Africa's MDM Growth Investments (MDM) said on Thursday it had acquired a 96 percent stake in telecommunications firm Multisource Holdings Ltd for about 22 million rand.
The company said the objective of the buy was to reconstitute Johannesburg Stock Exchange-listed Multisource as a private equity investment firm.
"Multisource will be restructured and its name will be changed to MDM Growth Investments Ltd," a company statement said.
It said the listed entity will have cash resources of approximately 17.5 million rand to apply to private equity investment opportunities.
It was planned that the resources be supplemented by a rights issue later this year, the statement added.

Commenting on the buy MDM's chief executive Malcolm Segal said: "At 2.55 rand per share, we are confident that we have acquired Multisource at an attractive price. We anticipate a significant improvement in trading results".
